choice.basis: The chart's y-axis is explicitly titled 'Reported clean-grid share (%)', which identifies the vertical bar geometry as the dashboard's encoding of the contribution metric. On this shared scale, the Offshore wind bar is the tallest, reaching a level between the 65 and 70 ticks (approx. 68). This is visibly higher than the Utility solar bar (approx. 40), the Hydro storage bar (approx. 52), and all other sources. Although the printed data labels (e.g., 41.2% for Utility solar) contradict the bar heights, the y-axis title provides the specific public basis for treating the bar heights as the reported values. Since Offshore wind has the largest reported contribution, it is the source that meets the routing criterion for priority review.
choice.option_label: Route Offshore wind to priority contribution review
